voiceover: Most budgets fail because they need willpower every single day. Here's a system that needs it once. Step one. Whatever is left in your spending account is yours, guilt free. You're not tracking every coffee. You're deciding once, then letting the system run. Set it up in one afternoon. Comment CASH and I'll send you the free template I use to map it out.
